paper.title: Equivalence of Context and Parameter Updates in Modern Transformer Blocks

C1.summary: One full Gemma 3 1B layer and five seeded toy trials pass the rank-one construction with negative controls.

C2.summary: All 26 sequential Gemma layers pass for one target history and token.

C3.summary: 40 actual-class trials pass with topology checks, NumPy cross-checks, and the nonzero-input control.

C4.summary: The paper's exact 87.5% naive bfloat16 percentage is not observed; the pinned run matches 100/100 tokens.

C5.summary: Stable bfloat16 lowers worst logit error but does not improve token agreement beyond the already 100/100 naive run.

C6.summary: Eight named actual Transformers architecture forms pass at reduced deterministic widths.

toy_baseline.summary: Five seeded d=64, hidden=128 rank-one trials pass; this is not full-model evidence.

full_paper_experiments.summary: Theorem proofs, every checkpoint, all image/Falcon studies, every ablation, and universal hardware behavior are outside this audit.
